native_core: fastPLS C++ CPU with two numerical threads
prediction_unit: Whole anonymous Bora group including disconnected pieces
fixed_components: Expert-derived previous coarse tiling with IDs anonymized only
Published Bora accurate-profile coverage converter, followed by calibrated shared-boundary chord fitting and final20-native-pixel cleanup
scope: Expand calibrated source groups before freezing one cohort used by all ten generations
training: Fit all parameters, prototypes, feature projections, gates and distillation targets on training source groups only
evaluation: Previously nontraining multiclass images plus qualified additions; evaluate every candidate on the same expanded cohort
selection: Adaptive reuse of test results requested by the user; these are development results, not an independent final test
accuracy_score: 0.50 times case-mean final GeoJSON IoU plus 0.30 times group balanced accuracy plus 0.20 times group top-one accuracy
latency_penalty: Subtract 0.05 times mean excess cached deployment seconds above one second per image
elegance_penalty: Subtract 0.002 times log2(1 + native PLS head count) plus 0.002 times additional structural stages
elegance_interpretation: Transparent operational simplicity proxy, not an objective proof of mathematical elegance or novelty
timing: Charge cached Bora, group pooling, required additional descriptors, warm prediction and GeoJSON export; report encoder and startup/refit separately
viewer: At every completed generation show the selected five methods on every eligible evaluation image; retain all twenty scorecards and lineage
evolution: Structural changes to evidence, target encoding, routing, fusion or learned residuals; changing only a seed or component count does not qualify
historical_stop: Earlier stopped boundary-refinement cycles remain stopped; this explicitly authorized classifier study is separate
